description: 국가철도공단_설계 [railways and stations] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 국가철도공단. 국가철도공단설계 데이터는 철도, 건설, 가치공학 분야에서 활용되는 설계VE(Value Engineering) 현황 자료로, 국가철도공단이 진행 중인 철도건설사업에 대한 설계 관련. Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 국가철도공단. Its tags are 철도, 건설, 가치공학, 설계VE, 설계분야. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-11-17 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
